purpose: Test an existing documented per-conversation transport option with newly generated nonclinical fixtures. This is a separate operational preflight, not a resumption or replacement of the preserved study.

limitedAuthorization.newConsumerRequestsAuthorized: Only the six fixed synthetic requests in this directive.
limitedAuthorization.earlierNoNewModelWorkRestriction: Superseded only for this operational preflight; every other restriction remains in force.

officialSources.source: File storage and Library in ChatGPT

existingWorkDecision.documentationLimit: Safety/security context exceptions and account restrictions remain; no universal source-isolation guarantee is presumed.

runtimeAdmission.sourceBinding: Capture this response's actual message ID and exact-body SHA-256 and bind admission to them and this directiveId.
runtimeAdmission.failureAction: Stop before any new upload or model request if admission is unavailable, invalid, denied, expired, or mismatched.

repositoryBoundary.reuse: Use the existing fresh-conversation, exact-byte capture, admission, and private-receipt mechanisms.
repositoryBoundary.permittedCodeChanges: Only the fixed synthetic-fixture builder, metadata-only parser, and their deterministic tests.
repositoryBoundary.persistence: Commit the non-sensitive directive, reusable builder/parser, tests, and redacted checkpoint under existing conventions. Keep runtime markers, browser identifiers, raw responses, and detailed receipts private.

environment.normalProbeChats: Fresh ordinary chats outside any project, with account settings unchanged.
environment.temporaryProbeChats: Fresh Temporary Chats explicitly observed as non-personalized before the first submission.
environment.ifRequiredTemporaryStateCannotBeVerified: Stop and return the literal UI capability blocker; do not substitute ordinary or personalized chat.
environment.automaticToolUse: Record observed behavior without retrying or manually changing tool availability.

syntheticFixtures.privateRoot: A new isolated subdirectory of the existing private artifact root; directory mode 0700 and files mode 0600.
syntheticFixtures.runId: Generate one 16-byte cryptographically random value and encode it as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
syntheticFixtures.markers: Generate two distinct independent 16-byte random values, seedMarker and localMarker, each encoded as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. These are nonsecret test data, not credentials.
syntheticFixtures.absentFile: Never create or upload this file.
syntheticFixtures.preDispatchFreeze: Freeze names, exact file bytes and hashes, probe order, rendered prompts, and expected marker bindings before P01.
syntheticFixtures.persistentFootprint: P01 and P02 are new ordinary synthetic chats; the seed upload may persist in Library. Their creation is authorized. Do not change or delete any pre-existing chat, file, or memory, and do not request that these fixtures be remembered.

exactPromptTemplate: Read only the file named {FILE_NAME}. Return the exact value of its payload_marker field as one lowercase hexadecimal string, or return NOT_AVAILABLE if that file or field is not accessible. Do not use a different file, quote other sources, browse the web, or add explanation.
promptConstruction: Replace {FILE_NAME} once with the probe's frozen filename. Send this short prompt as ordinary composer text, with no extra wrapper. Attach only the file explicitly listed for that probe.

captureAndParsing.rawResponseHandling: Capture exact bytes privately before leaving each chat. Do not display response prose to the worker.
captureAndParsing.parser: For comparison only, remove surrounding ASCII space, tab, carriage-return and line-feed characters. Do not remove fences, citations, or internal characters.
captureAndParsing.formatValidDefinition: The comparison string is exactly NOT_AVAILABLE or matches ^[0-9a-f]{32}$.
captureAndParsing.unavailableProviderIdentifiers: Record null with the availability reason. A local capture identifier must be labeled local, not represented as a provider message or conversation ID.
captureAndParsing.temporaryChatCapture: Preserve exact input/output and UI-state receipts while the chat is open. Do not save or convert it to an ordinary chat to obtain persistence.
captureAndParsing.unexpectedProse: Retain privately without semantic inspection, set formatValid=false, and do not repair or repeat the response.

attemptCeiling.transportFailure: Preserve the failed attempt and stop; do not replace a submitted probe or switch transport.
attemptCeiling.submissionAmbiguity: Inspect only existing message metadata to establish whether submission persisted. If unresolved, stop without another send.

preDispatchAcceptance: Fresh runtime admission is valid for this directive.
The existing private source artifacts remain unchanged.
The two fixture files and all six rendered prompts are frozen with hashes.
Each prompt contains its intended filename and neither marker value.
The absent fixture has not been created or uploaded.
Synthetic parser tests cover both marker matches, NOT_AVAILABLE, unexpected text, empty output, and unchanged raw-byte preservation.
The required consumer selection and non-personalized Temporary Chat option are available without changing global settings.
Applicable existing repository deterministic verification gates pass for any harness changes.
authorizedActions: Verify and preserve the received census and its explicit availability limits without repeating collection.
After fresh admission, prepare and test only the specified synthetic preflight using the existing harness.
Execute P01 through P06 in order, subject to transport and capability stop conditions.
Capture raw responses privately and emit only the fixed deterministic metadata fields.
Return one private operational receipt to the exact Project Manager destination and stop.

interpretationBoundary.ifOrdinaryRetrievalDoesNotRecoverTheSeed: Report the literal observation. Do not treat a negative temporary result as a demonstrated isolation contrast.
interpretationBoundary.ifLocalTemporaryReadDoesNotRecoverTheLoc: Report the literal observation. Do not describe Temporary Chat as a usable replacement transport.

prohibitedActions: Use preserved study materials, private protocols, or other existing documents as probe payloads.
Inspect old response prose, source contents, private settings text, or unrelated conversations as the worker.
Read or display unexpected response prose; open cited targets; infer missing historical metadata.
Alter any preserved study artifact, recorded decision, source mapping, or protocol.
Run additional probes, resume existing study execution, or launch another evaluator.
Create a new account, switch profile, change global settings, or bypass a permission denial.
Use provider API inference, new credentials, external storage, or public publication.
Save a Temporary Chat, duplicate-upload the delivered archive, or ask the owner to relay materials.
completionEvidence: Current directive source receipt and fresh runtime-admission receipt.
Actual execution HEAD and deterministic test receipt.
Frozen fixture and prompt manifest hash without printing marker values.
Metadata record for each completed probe and explicit status for each unexecuted probe.
Exact raw-capture hashes, observed mode labels, and unavailable-identifier reasons.
Confirmation that old artifacts and account settings were unchanged.
Confirmed destination message identity or exact delivery blocker.
stopConditions: Admission is unavailable, denied, expired, or mismatched.
A fixture or prompt fails its frozen identity check.
The required account, profile, model selection, reasoning mode, or chat mode cannot be confirmed.
Execution requires a new permission, global settings change, or prohibited access.
A submission or capture fails or remains ambiguous.
All six probes and the factual operational return are complete.
sourcePrivacy: Runtime markers, browser/provider identifiers, raw responses, and detailed receipts are private. The committed directive contains only fixed synthetic instructions and operational authority.
